versos.hebraico: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃

controles.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
controles.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
controles.livre: Melhor é o pobre que anda em sua honestidade do que o perverso de lábios e tolo.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא־דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃

controles.web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
controles.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
controles.livre: E não é bom a alma sem conhecimento; e quem tem pés apressados comete erros.

versos.hebraico: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.
controles.livre: A loucura do homem perverte seu caminho; e seu coração se ira contra o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃

controles.web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
controles.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
controles.livre: A riqueza faz ganhar muitos amigos; mas ao pobre, até seu amigo o abandona.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃

controles.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
controles.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
controles.livre: A falsa testemunha não ficará impune; e quem fala mentiras não escapará.

versos.hebraico: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־נָדִ֑יב וְכָל־הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃

controles.web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
controles.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
controles.livre: Muitos suplicam perante o príncipe; e todos querem ser amigos daquele que dá presentes.

versos.hebraico: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי־רָ֨שׁ׀ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לא־הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
controles.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
controles.livre: Todos os irmãos do pobre o odeiam; ainda mais seus amigos se afastam dele; ele corre atrás deles com palavras, mas eles nada lhe respondem .

versos.hebraico: קֹֽנֶה־לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
controles.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
controles.livre: Quem adquire entendimento ama sua alma; quem guarda a prudência encontrará o bem.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃פ

controles.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
controles.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
controles.livre: A falsa testemunha não ficará impune; e quem fala mentiras perecerá.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְעֶ֤בֶד׀ מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
controles.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
controles.livre: O luxo não é adequado ao tolo; muito menos ao servo dominar sobre príncipes.

versos.hebraico: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־פָּֽשַׁע׃

controles.web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
controles.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
controles.livre: A prudência do homem retém sua ira; e sua glória é ignorar a ofensa.

versos.hebraico: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
controles.kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
controles.livre: A fúria do rei é como o rugido de um leão; mas seu favor é como orvalho sobre a erva.

versos.hebraico: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
controles.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
controles.livre: O filho tolo é uma desgraça ao seu pai; e brigas da esposa são como uma goteira duradoura.

versos.hebraico: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃

controles.web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
controles.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.
controles.livre: A casa e as riquezas são a herança dos pais; porém a mulher prudente vem do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃

controles.web: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
controles.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
controles.livre: A preguiça faz cair num sono profundo; e a alma desocupada passará fome.

versos.hebraico: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יומת׃

controles.web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
controles.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
controles.livre: Quem guarda o mandamento cuida de sua alma; e quem despreza seus caminhos morrerá.

versos.hebraico: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
controles.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
controles.livre: Quem faz misericórdia ao pobre empresta ao SENHOR; e ele lhe pagará sua recompensa.

versos.hebraico: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
controles.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
controles.livre: Castiga a teu filho enquanto há esperança; mas não levantes tua alma para o matar.

versos.hebraico: גרל־חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃

controles.web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
controles.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
controles.livre: Aquele que tem grande irá será punido; porque se tu o livrares, terás de fazer o mesmo de novo.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
controles.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
controles.livre: Ouve o conselho, e recebe a disciplina; para que sejas sábio nos teus últimos dias .

versos.hebraico: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
controles.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.
controles.livre: Há muitos pensamentos no coração do homem; porém o conselho do SENHOR prevalecerá.

versos.hebraico: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃

controles.web: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
controles.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
controles.livre: O que se deseja do homem é sua bondade; porém o pobre é melhor do que o homem mentiroso.

versos.hebraico: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל־יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃

controles.web: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
controles.kjv: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
controles.livre: O temor ao SENHOR encaminha para a vida; aquele que o tem habitará satisfeito, nem mal algum o visitará.

versos.hebraico: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
controles.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
controles.livre: O preguiçoso põe sua mão no prato, e nem sequer a leva de volta à boca.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃

controles.web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
controles.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
controles.livre: Fere ao zombador, e o ingênuo será precavido; e repreende ao prudente, e ele aprenderá conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃

controles.web: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
controles.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
controles.livre: Aquele que prejudica ao pai ou afugenta a mãe é filho causador de vergonha e de desgraça.

versos.hebraico: חַֽדַל־בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
controles.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
controles.livre: Filho meu, deixa de ouvir a instrução, então te desviarás das palavras de conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע־אָֽוֶן׃

controles.web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
controles.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
controles.livre: A má testemunha escarnece do juízo; e a boca dos perversos engole injustiça.

versos.hebraico: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃

controles.web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
controles.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
controles.livre: Julgamentos estão preparados para zombadores, e açoites para as costas dos tolos.
